note: Gates of the gap pilot's side commitment (configs/obstacles/gap_pilot.json version 5 against version 2, configs/obstacles/gap_pilot_v2.json), scored by haltere.obstacles.gap_commit_eval score. Frozen with its sha256 together with the version 3 declaration before any gate is scored. Every replay is open loop (development evidence, never flight evidence). Hindsight inputs (impact times, pillar boxes from the scene colliders and the impact anatomy, checkpoint-switch times from the logged cue) select and score ticks only. Seen before the freeze: minus-fast6-vg-02 (the development case: its log, video and depth replay; no candidate was scored on it) and the Straw Bale development store runs 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 13, 14, 15 (report-only dev check of the candidate; not a gate). Between version 1 and 2 of these gates the version 2 and baseline-tree replays were generated (not read) and the version 3 candidate replays were generated and deleted unread. Version 3 of these gates: the same gates for gap pilot version 5, a revision made after version 4 was scored on every data set here; the version 5 scores are development evidence, not held-out.

offline_replay.basis: teacher (the runtime 336 x 602 depth input; gap_cue_eval flight_sequence / store_sequence with configs/obstacles/gap_cue.json version 2)
offline_replay.cache: the gap-cue evaluation cache of m2-gapcue (session scratchpad m2impl/gapcue: flights/, depth/, store_masks.npz), read only
offline_replay.rule: per frame: the decision (shift if valid, kind, ring bearing, lr, near_on_path with the motor's response model) is a gap sample received gap_latency_s after capture (live gap age p50 76-96 ms); the ring bearing reaches the pilot cue_latency_s after capture and is reconciled (ring conflict); GapAim alone at 1/tick_s Hz; no flag clearance, no terrain votes

live_replay.rule: every logged tick through FastRaceCue with the deployed stack (gap aim, lag turn, wall-pilot rules, vertical guard); the logged gap samples carry the logged near_on_path

C_pillar_c.what: minus-fast6-vg-02 (the development case): with version 3 the deployed stack never aims toward pillar C, confirms its free (RIGHT) side early and holds it without decay to the impact
C_pillar_c.free_side: right: the next ring lies right of the pillar (hindsight triangulation (79.7, 40.4)); store runs 122-131 passed at x 79.3-80.7, the pillar spans x 77.85-78.55 (Pillar01 collider)
C_pillar_c.rule: from window_start_t (the pillar-C ring's first in-view sample) to the recorded impact: no tick with a LEFT applied shift; the first tick with a RIGHT obstacle target at least min_lead_s before the impact (version 2: 0.39 s; the second live right vote arrived about 0.95 s before it); from it to the impact the target is RIGHT at every tick and its magnitude never decreases

A_pillar_a.what: pillar A in every Minus Two log that reached it: not worse than version 2
A_pillar_a.rule: per approach, version 3 against version 2 on the same samples: the first tick with a LEFT (ring side) obstacle target in the approach region is at least as far from the pillar (within tolerance_m; both none also passes); no more ticks with a RIGHT obstacle target in the region; no more ticks whose flown aim (ring bearing + applied shift) lies inside the pillar's azimuth extent while the ring does not. The gate passes when every approach passes

B_pillar_b.what: pillar B: the pilot shifts toward world -x at least 1 s before the impact (G2 at the pilot level)
B_pillar_b.rule: version 3: on both runs the first tick in the window whose obstacle target points to world -x (target * -sin(ring bearing) < 0) has time to impact >= min_lead_s

P_pillar_c_passes.what: runs that passed pillar C on its free (right) side: not pushed toward the pillar
P_pillar_c_passes.rule: per run, version 3 against version 2: no more region ticks with a LEFT applied shift, no more ticks whose flown aim lies inside the pillar's azimuth extent while the ring does not

S_straw.what: clean Straw Bale laps (the G3 flights) at the pilot level: no more episodes than version 2
S_straw.rule: pooled over the laps: episodes (runs of a nonzero target, split at side changes, with onset in flown time: frame gaps < 0.3 s) per minute, version 3 <= version 2; checkpoint switches (gap_cue_eval.checkpoint_switches) whose last switch_window_s before the pilot sees the switch keep |applied| <= switch_abs_shift_max_deg: version 3 fraction >= min(version 2 fraction, switch_min_fraction). Reported: engaged share, p90 |applied|
S_straw.cue_level_note: the per-frame cue and its own two-frame confirmation are unchanged: G3 of configs/obstacles/gap_cue_gates.json stays 9.3 episodes/min (FAIL against 6; docs/gap_cue.md)

L_leaks.what: G4 leak tests not worse: the per-frame cue is unchanged
L_leaks.rule: gap_cue.json content sha256 unchanged, and gap_cue_eval score re-run with this code on the cached frames (OUT/cue_rescore) reproduces the reference G4 numbers on both bases exactly

O_identity.what: nothing changes with the stack off; in shadow the flown command is unchanged; version 2 through this code is version 2
O_identity.rule: bitwise equality per tick of the command keys (cvx, cvy, cvz, yaw_cmd, state, cap, climb, descent_scale) and, for "gap" pairs, of gap_target, gap_applied and gap_offset; BASE: = the baseline tree's replay with its own declarations

change: v3: only declarations.candidate_version (4 -> 5) and the note. Every gate, threshold and data set is unchanged; B stays as frozen although version 2 fails it at the pilot level too.

previous_versions.scored: gap pilot version 4: C, P, L, O pass; A, B, S fail (docs/experiments/gap_commit_v4_results.json)
